svg.title: Six layers, one forecast
svg.desc: Exploded view of the firespread forecast for Hermits Peak 2022: terrain, fuel, canopy, weather and the fire start, each with its source and resolution, stacked under the burn probability by hour they produce on one shared 30 m grid.

g.text: HRRR hourly 10 m wind, temperature, humidity, cloud

svg.text: 2400 × 2400 cells · 30 m · 72 km a side · EPSG:5070
